resolution: Evaluated the proposed opt-in transactional reload gate against the actual ReactJIT dev pipeline. Confirmed it is feasible at the correct boundary: watcher/esbuild already produces and sends a candidate bundle; dev_ipc owns the bytes and queues them before teardown; v8_app currently destroys the live context only because processIncomingPushes immediately upserts and switchToTab/evalActiveTab. The host also already supports NOTICE → system:notification. Proposed --reload=ask/manual modes that stage the candidate while the old app remains live, show a generated carry/save dialog, export selected narrow handoff values once, require Save All success for durable work, then teardown/eval/import/clear; clean reload and Later remain explicit choices. Noted this avoids continuous hotstate mirroring and the previously documented auto-hotstate schema crash-loop. No files changed.
